import ZFCinPA.ModelCodedDecoderAtomicVacuity254

set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
Positive source codes are fresh named labels for their own decoded formulas.
The proof uses internal Pi1 order induction, not external standardness or a
free-variable bound confused with the target syntax's bound-variable bound.
The literal decoder zero contains free label zero and is explicitly excluded.
-/
namespace LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedDecoderFreshness254
open LO LO.FirstOrder LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic.Bootstrapping LO.FirstOrder.SetTheory
open LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedBindOne
open LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedNamedBinderLaws
open LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedDecoder254
open LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedDecoderAtomicVacuity254
open scoped LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]
variable {L : Language} [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable]

private instance termBindOneAt_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₃[V] (termBindOneAt L) :=
  termBindOneAt_defined.graph_delta.to_definable
private instance bindOneAt_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₃[V] (bindOneAt L) :=
  bindOneAt_defined.graph_delta.to_definable
private instance decode_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₁[V] decode :=
  decode_defined.graph_delta.to_definable

lemma bindOneAt_isUFormula {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    ∀ chosen depth : V, IsUFormula L (bindOneAt L chosen depth p) := by
  apply IsUFormula.ISigma1.pi1_succ_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ p hp
  · definability
  · intro arity R terms hR ht a d
    rw [bindOneAt_rel a d hR ht]
    simp [hR,termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d ht]
  · intro arity R terms hR ht a d
    rw [bindOneAt_nrel a d hR ht]
    simp [hR,termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d ht]
  · intro a d; simp
  · intro a d; simp
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq a d
    rw [bindOneAt_and a d hp hq]
    simp [ihp a d,ihq a d]
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq a d
    rw [bindOneAt_or a d hp hq]
    simp [ihp a d,ihq a d]
  · intro p hp ih a d
    rw [bindOneAt_all a d hp]
    simp [ih a (d+1)]
  · intro p hp ih a d
    rw [bindOneAt_exs a d hp]
    simp [ih a (d+1)]

/-- Binding different free labels commutes when each keeps its own depth.
This is raw syntax; no claim swaps two quantified slots without substitution. -/
lemma termBindOneAt_commute {term : V} (ht : IsUTerm L term) :
    ∀ a b d e : V, a ≠ b →
    termBindOneAt L a d (termBindOneAt L b e term) =
      termBindOneAt L b e (termBindOneAt L a d term) := by
  apply IsUTerm.induction 𝚷 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ term ht
  · definability
  · intro z a b d e hab; simp
  · intro x a b d e hab
    classical
    by_cases ha : x = a
    · subst x
      simp [termBindOneAt_fvar,hab]
    · by_cases hb : x = b
      · subst x
        simp [termBindOneAt_fvar,hab.symm]
      · simp [termBindOneAt_fvar,ha,hb]
  · intro arity f terms hf hv ih a b d e hab
    rw [termBindOneAt_func b e hf hv,
      termBindOneAt_func a d hf (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b e hv),
      termBindOneAt_func a d hf hv,
      termBindOneAt_func b e hf (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d hv)]
    apply congrArg (fun args => ^func arity f args)
    apply nth_ext' arity
    · simp [termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b e hv]
    · simp [termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d hv]
    · intro i hi
      rw [nth_termBindOneVecAt a d (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b e hv) hi,
        nth_termBindOneVecAt b e hv hi,
        nth_termBindOneVecAt b e (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d hv) hi,
        nth_termBindOneVecAt a d hv hi]
      exact ih i hi a b d e hab

lemma termBindOneVecAt_commute {arity terms : V} (ht : IsUTermVec L arity terms)
    (a b d e : V) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    termBindOneVecAt L a d arity (termBindOneVecAt L b e arity terms) =
      termBindOneVecAt L b e arity (termBindOneVecAt L a d arity terms) := by
  apply nth_ext' arity
  · simp [termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b e ht]
  · simp [termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d ht]
  · intro i hi
    rw [nth_termBindOneVecAt a d (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b e ht) hi,
      nth_termBindOneVecAt b e ht hi,
      nth_termBindOneVecAt b e (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d ht) hi,
      nth_termBindOneVecAt a d ht hi]
    exact termBindOneAt_commute (ht.nth hi) a b d e hab

lemma bindOneAt_commute {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    ∀ a b d e : V, a ≠ b →
    bindOneAt L a d (bindOneAt L b e p) =
      bindOneAt L b e (bindOneAt L a d p) := by
  apply IsUFormula.ISigma1.pi1_succ_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ p hp
  · definability
  · intro arity R terms hR ht a b d e hab
    rw [bindOneAt_rel b e hR ht,
      bindOneAt_rel a d hR (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b e ht),
      termBindOneVecAt_commute ht a b d e hab,
      bindOneAt_rel a d hR ht,
      bindOneAt_rel b e hR (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d ht)]
  · intro arity R terms hR ht a b d e hab
    rw [bindOneAt_nrel b e hR ht,
      bindOneAt_nrel a d hR (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b e ht),
      termBindOneVecAt_commute ht a b d e hab,
      bindOneAt_nrel a d hR ht,
      bindOneAt_nrel b e hR (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d ht)]
  · intro a b d e hab; simp
  · intro a b d e hab; simp
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq a b d e hab
    rw [bindOneAt_and b e hp hq,
      bindOneAt_and a d (bindOneAt_isUFormula hp b e) (bindOneAt_isUFormula hq b e),
      bindOneAt_and a d hp hq,
      bindOneAt_and b e (bindOneAt_isUFormula hp a d) (bindOneAt_isUFormula hq a d),
      ihp a b d e hab,ihq a b d e hab]
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq a b d e hab
    rw [bindOneAt_or b e hp hq,
      bindOneAt_or a d (bindOneAt_isUFormula hp b e) (bindOneAt_isUFormula hq b e),
      bindOneAt_or a d hp hq,
      bindOneAt_or b e (bindOneAt_isUFormula hp a d) (bindOneAt_isUFormula hq a d),
      ihp a b d e hab,ihq a b d e hab]
  · intro p hp ih a b d e hab
    rw [bindOneAt_all b e hp,
      bindOneAt_all a d (bindOneAt_isUFormula hp b (e+1)),
      bindOneAt_all a d hp,
      bindOneAt_all b e (bindOneAt_isUFormula hp a (d+1)),
      ih a b (d+1) (e+1) hab]
  · intro p hp ih a b d e hab
    rw [bindOneAt_exs b e hp,
      bindOneAt_exs a d (bindOneAt_isUFormula hp b (e+1)),
      bindOneAt_exs a d hp,
      bindOneAt_exs b e (bindOneAt_isUFormula hp a (d+1)),
      ih a b (d+1) (e+1) hab]

private lemma formula_at_depth {p : V} (hp : IsFormula L p) (depth : V) :
    IsSemiformula L depth p :=
  ⟨hp.isUFormula,le_trans hp.bv_le (by simp)⟩

lemma atomCode_binder_fresh (symbol a b chosen depth : V)
    (hr : (ℒₛₑₜ).IsRel 2 symbol) (ha : a ≠ chosen) (hb : b ≠ chosen) :
    bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ chosen depth (atomCode symbol a b) = atomCode symbol a b := by
  unfold atomCode
  rw [bindOneAt_rel chosen depth hr (by simp),
    termBindOneVecAt_pair chosen depth _ _ (by simp) (by simp),
    termBindOneAt_other chosen depth a ha,termBindOneAt_other chosen depth b hb]

/-- Internal order induction includes code zero only with a positive chosen
label. Every label read from a positive source row is strictly below its code. -/
theorem decode_binder_fresh (code : V) :
    ∀ chosen depth : V, 0 < chosen → code ≤ chosen →
    bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ chosen depth (decode code) = decode code := by
  induction code using ISigma1.pi1_order_induction
  · definability
  case ind code ih =>
    intro chosen depth hchosen hle
    have hr0 : (ℒₛₑₜ).IsRel (2 : V) 0 := by
      simpa using (isRel_quote_quote (V := V) (L := ℒₛₑₜ) (k := 2) (x := 0)).mpr
        ⟨Language.Set.Rel.eq,rfl⟩
    have hr1 : (ℒₛₑₜ).IsRel (2 : V) 1 := by
      simpa using (isRel_quote_quote (V := V) (L := ℒₛₑₜ) (k := 2) (x := 1)).mpr
        ⟨Language.Set.Rel.mem,rfl⟩
    by_cases hz : code = 0
    · subst code
      rw [decode_zero]
      unfold zeroFormula
      rw [bindOneAt_imp (formula_at_depth (memCode_isFormula 0 0) depth)
        (formula_at_depth (memCode_isFormula 0 0) depth) chosen,
        atomCode_binder_fresh 1 0 0 chosen depth hr1 (ne_of_lt hchosen) (ne_of_lt hchosen)]
    · have hpos : 0 < code := lt_of_le_of_ne (by simp) (Ne.symm hz)
      have ha := (child_bounds hpos).1
      have hb := (child_bounds hpos).2
      have hia (d : V) := ih _ ha chosen d hchosen (le_trans (le_of_lt ha) hle)
      have hib (d : V) := ih _ hb chosen d hchosen (le_trans (le_of_lt hb) hle)
      have hna : _root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCantor.first (code/4) ≠ chosen :=
        ne_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le ha hle)
      have hnb : _root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCantor.second (code/4) ≠ chosen :=
        ne_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hb hle)
      rw [decode_positive code hz]
      by_cases h0 : code%4 = 0
      · simp only [h0,if_pos]
        rw [bindOneAt_imp (formula_at_depth (decode_isFormula _) depth)
          (formula_at_depth (decode_isFormula _) depth) chosen,hia depth,hib depth]
      · by_cases h1 : code%4 = 1
        · simp only [h0,h1,if_false,if_pos]
          exact atomCode_binder_fresh 1 _ _ chosen depth hr1 hna hnb
        · by_cases h2 : code%4 = 2
          · simp only [h0,h1,h2,if_false,if_pos,namedAll]
            rw [bindOneAt_all chosen depth (bindOneAt_isSemiformula (decode_isFormula _) _).isUFormula,
              bindOneAt_commute (decode_isFormula _).isUFormula chosen _ (depth+1) 0 hna.symm,
              hib (depth+1)]
          · simp only [h0,h1,h2,if_false]
            exact atomCode_binder_fresh 0 _ _ chosen depth hr0 hna hnb

theorem positive_code_fresh (code : V) (h : 0 < code) (depth : V) :
    bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ code depth (decode code) = decode code :=
  decode_binder_fresh code code depth h le_rfl

/-- A direct client of the freshness theorem; no target set axiom or GEN rule
is assumed. This does not yet construct the internal Collection instance. -/
theorem decoded_positive_vacuity (T : SetTheory) [T.Δ₁] (code : V) (h : 0 < code) :
    Provable T (decode (_root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wim code
      (_root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wal code code))) :=
  decoded_vacuity_of_bindOne T code code (positive_code_fresh code h 0)

end LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedDecoderFreshness254

#print axioms LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedDecoderFreshness254.positive_code_fresh
#print axioms LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedDecoderFreshness254.decoded_positive_vacuity
example {p : V} (h : IsUFormula L p) (a d : V) :
    IsUFormula L (bindOneAt L a d p) := bindOneAt_isUFormula h a d
example {t : V} (h : IsUTerm L t) (a b d e : V) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    termBindOneAt L a d (termBindOneAt L b e t) =
      termBindOneAt L b e (termBindOneAt L a d t) := termBindOneAt_commute h a b d e hab
example {k ts : V} (h : IsUTermVec L k ts) (a b d e : V) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    termBindOneVecAt L a d k (termBindOneVecAt L b e k ts) =
      termBindOneVecAt L b e k (termBindOneVecAt L a d k ts) := termBindOneVecAt_commute h a b d e hab
example {p : V} (h : IsUFormula L p) (a b d e : V) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    bindOneAt L a d (bindOneAt L b e p) =
      bindOneAt L b e (bindOneAt L a d p) := bindOneAt_commute h a b d e hab
example (r a b c d : V) (hr : (ℒₛₑₜ).IsRel 2 r) (ha : a ≠ c) (hb : b ≠ c) :
    bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ c d (atomCode r a b) = atomCode r a b :=
  atomCode_binder_fresh r a b c d hr ha hb
example (n c d : V) (hc : 0 < c) (h : n ≤ c) :
    bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ c d (decode n) = decode n := decode_binder_fresh n c d hc h
example (n d : V) (hn : 0 < n) : bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ n d (decode n) = decode n :=
  positive_code_fresh n hn d
example (T : SetTheory) [T.Δ₁] (n : V) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Provable T (decode (_root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wim n
      (_root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wal n n))) :=
  decoded_positive_vacuity T n hn
example (d : V) : bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ 1 d (decode (0 : V)) = decode (0 : V) :=
  decode_binder_fresh 0 1 d (by simp) (by simp)
example (d : V) : bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ 1 d (decode (1 : V)) = decode (1 : V) :=
  positive_code_fresh 1 (by simp) d
example (n : V) : bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ (n+1) 0 (decode n) = decode n :=
  decode_binder_fresh n (n+1) 0 (by simp) (by simp)
example (n : V) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Provable (𝗭𝗙 : SetTheory) (decode (_root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wim n
      (_root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wal n n))) :=
  decoded_positive_vacuity 𝗭𝗙 n hn

import ZFCinPA.ModelCodedDecoderAtomicVacuity254

set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
Positive source codes are fresh named labels for their own decoded formulas.
The proof uses internal Pi1 order induction, not external standardness or a
free-variable bound confused with the target syntax's bound-variable bound.
The literal decoder zero contains free label zero and is explicitly excluded.
-/
namespace LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedDecoderFreshness254
open LO LO.FirstOrder LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic.Bootstrapping LO.FirstOrder.SetTheory
open LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedBindOne
open LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedNamedBinderLaws
open LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedDecoder254
open LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedDecoderAtomicVacuity254
open scoped LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]
variable {L : Language} [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable]

private instance termBindOneAt_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₃[V] (termBindOneAt L) :=
  termBindOneAt_defined.graph_delta.to_definable
private instance bindOneAt_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₃[V] (bindOneAt L) :=
  bindOneAt_defined.graph_delta.to_definable
private instance decode_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₁[V] decode :=
  decode_defined.graph_delta.to_definable

lemma bindOneAt_isUFormula {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    ∀ chosen depth : V, IsUFormula L (bindOneAt L chosen depth p) := by
  apply IsUFormula.ISigma1.pi1_succ_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ p hp
  · definability
  · intro arity R terms hR ht a d
    rw [bindOneAt_rel a d hR ht]
    simp [hR,termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d ht]
  · intro arity R terms hR ht a d
    rw [bindOneAt_nrel a d hR ht]
    simp [hR,termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d ht]
  · intro a d; simp
  · intro a d; simp
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq a d
    rw [bindOneAt_and a d hp hq]
    simp [ihp a d,ihq a d]
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq a d
    rw [bindOneAt_or a d hp hq]
    simp [ihp a d,ihq a d]
  · intro p hp ih a d
    rw [bindOneAt_all a d hp]
    simp [ih a (d+1)]
  · intro p hp ih a d
    rw [bindOneAt_exs a d hp]
    simp [ih a (d+1)]

/-- Binding different free labels commutes when each keeps its own depth.
This is raw syntax; no claim swaps two quantified slots without substitution. -/
lemma termBindOneAt_commute {term : V} (ht : IsUTerm L term) :
    ∀ a b d e : V, a ≠ b →
    termBindOneAt L a d (termBindOneAt L b e term) =
      termBindOneAt L b e (termBindOneAt L a d term) := by
  apply IsUTerm.induction 𝚷 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ term ht
  · definability
  · intro z a b d e hab; simp
  · intro x a b d e hab
    classical
    by_cases ha : x = a
    · subst x
      simp [termBindOneAt_fvar,hab]
    · by_cases hb : x = b
      · subst x
        simp [termBindOneAt_fvar,hab.symm]
      · simp [termBindOneAt_fvar,ha,hb]
  · intro arity f terms hf hv ih a b d e hab
    rw [termBindOneAt_func b e hf hv,
      termBindOneAt_func a d hf (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b e hv),
      termBindOneAt_func a d hf hv,
      termBindOneAt_func b e hf (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d hv)]
    apply congrArg (fun args => ^func arity f args)
    apply nth_ext' arity
    · simp [termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b e hv]
    · simp [termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d hv]
    · intro i hi
      rw [nth_termBindOneVecAt a d (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b e hv) hi,
        nth_termBindOneVecAt b e hv hi,
        nth_termBindOneVecAt b e (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d hv) hi,
        nth_termBindOneVecAt a d hv hi]
      exact ih i hi a b d e hab

lemma termBindOneVecAt_commute {arity terms : V} (ht : IsUTermVec L arity terms)
    (a b d e : V) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    termBindOneVecAt L a d arity (termBindOneVecAt L b e arity terms) =
      termBindOneVecAt L b e arity (termBindOneVecAt L a d arity terms) := by
  apply nth_ext' arity
  · simp [termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b e ht]
  · simp [termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d ht]
  · intro i hi
    rw [nth_termBindOneVecAt a d (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b e ht) hi,
      nth_termBindOneVecAt b e ht hi,
      nth_termBindOneVecAt b e (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d ht) hi,
      nth_termBindOneVecAt a d ht hi]
    exact termBindOneAt_commute (ht.nth hi) a b d e hab

lemma bindOneAt_commute {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    ∀ a b d e : V, a ≠ b →
    bindOneAt L a d (bindOneAt L b e p) =
      bindOneAt L b e (bindOneAt L a d p) := by
  apply IsUFormula.ISigma1.pi1_succ_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ p hp
  · definability
  · intro arity R terms hR ht a b d e hab
    rw [bindOneAt_rel b e hR ht,
      bindOneAt_rel a d hR (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b e ht),
      termBindOneVecAt_commute ht a b d e hab,
      bindOneAt_rel a d hR ht,
      bindOneAt_rel b e hR (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d ht)]
  · intro arity R terms hR ht a b d e hab
    rw [bindOneAt_nrel b e hR ht,
      bindOneAt_nrel a d hR (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b e ht),
      termBindOneVecAt_commute ht a b d e hab,
      bindOneAt_nrel a d hR ht,
      bindOneAt_nrel b e hR (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d ht)]
  · intro a b d e hab; simp
  · intro a b d e hab; simp
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq a b d e hab
    rw [bindOneAt_and b e hp hq,
      bindOneAt_and a d (bindOneAt_isUFormula hp b e) (bindOneAt_isUFormula hq b e),
      bindOneAt_and a d hp hq,
      bindOneAt_and b e (bindOneAt_isUFormula hp a d) (bindOneAt_isUFormula hq a d),
      ihp a b d e hab,ihq a b d e hab]
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq a b d e hab
    rw [bindOneAt_or b e hp hq,
      bindOneAt_or a d (bindOneAt_isUFormula hp b e) (bindOneAt_isUFormula hq b e),
      bindOneAt_or a d hp hq,
      bindOneAt_or b e (bindOneAt_isUFormula hp a d) (bindOneAt_isUFormula hq a d),
      ihp a b d e hab,ihq a b d e hab]
  · intro p hp ih a b d e hab
    rw [bindOneAt_all b e hp,
      bindOneAt_all a d (bindOneAt_isUFormula hp b (e+1)),
      bindOneAt_all a d hp,
      bindOneAt_all b e (bindOneAt_isUFormula hp a (d+1)),
      ih a b (d+1) (e+1) hab]
  · intro p hp ih a b d e hab
    rw [bindOneAt_exs b e hp,
      bindOneAt_exs a d (bindOneAt_isUFormula hp b (e+1)),
      bindOneAt_exs a d hp,
      bindOneAt_exs b e (bindOneAt_isUFormula hp a (d+1)),
      ih a b (d+1) (e+1) hab]

private lemma formula_at_depth {p : V} (hp : IsFormula L p) (depth : V) :
    IsSemiformula L depth p :=
  ⟨hp.isUFormula,le_trans hp.bv_le (by simp)⟩

lemma atomCode_binder_fresh (symbol a b chosen depth : V)
    (hr : (ℒₛₑₜ).IsRel 2 symbol) (ha : a ≠ chosen) (hb : b ≠ chosen) :
    bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ chosen depth (atomCode symbol a b) = atomCode symbol a b := by
  unfold atomCode
  rw [bindOneAt_rel chosen depth hr (by simp),
    termBindOneVecAt_pair chosen depth _ _ (by simp) (by simp),
    termBindOneAt_other chosen depth a ha,termBindOneAt_other chosen depth b hb]

/-- Internal order induction includes code zero only with a positive chosen
label. Every label read from a positive source row is strictly below its code. -/
theorem decode_binder_fresh (code : V) :
    ∀ chosen depth : V, 0 < chosen → code ≤ chosen →
    bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ chosen depth (decode code) = decode code := by
  induction code using ISigma1.pi1_order_induction
  · definability
  case ind code ih =>
    intro chosen depth hchosen hle
    have hr0 : (ℒₛₑₜ).IsRel (2 : V) 0 := by
      simpa using (isRel_quote_quote (V := V) (L := ℒₛₑₜ) (k := 2) (x := 0)).mpr
        ⟨Language.Set.Rel.eq,rfl⟩
    have hr1 : (ℒₛₑₜ).IsRel (2 : V) 1 := by
      simpa using (isRel_quote_quote (V := V) (L := ℒₛₑₜ) (k := 2) (x := 1)).mpr
        ⟨Language.Set.Rel.mem,rfl⟩
    by_cases hz : code = 0
    · subst code
      rw [decode_zero]
      unfold zeroFormula
      rw [bindOneAt_imp (formula_at_depth (memCode_isFormula 0 0) depth)
        (formula_at_depth (memCode_isFormula 0 0) depth) chosen,
        atomCode_binder_fresh 1 0 0 chosen depth hr1 (ne_of_lt hchosen) (ne_of_lt hchosen)]
    · have hpos : 0 < code := lt_of_le_of_ne (by simp) (Ne.symm hz)
      have ha := (child_bounds hpos).1
      have hb := (child_bounds hpos).2
      have hia (d : V) := ih _ ha chosen d hchosen (le_trans (le_of_lt ha) hle)
      have hib (d : V) := ih _ hb chosen d hchosen (le_trans (le_of_lt hb) hle)
      have hna : _root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCantor.first (code/4) ≠ chosen :=
        ne_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le ha hle)
      have hnb : _root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCantor.second (code/4) ≠ chosen :=
        ne_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hb hle)
      rw [decode_positive code hz]
      by_cases h0 : code%4 = 0
      · simp only [h0,if_pos]
        rw [bindOneAt_imp (formula_at_depth (decode_isFormula _) depth)
          (formula_at_depth (decode_isFormula _) depth) chosen,hia depth,hib depth]
      · by_cases h1 : code%4 = 1
        · simp only [h0,h1,if_false,if_pos]
          exact atomCode_binder_fresh 1 _ _ chosen depth hr1 hna hnb
        · by_cases h2 : code%4 = 2
          · simp only [h0,h1,h2,if_false,if_pos,namedAll]
            rw [bindOneAt_all chosen depth (bindOneAt_isSemiformula (decode_isFormula _) _).isUFormula,
              bindOneAt_commute (decode_isFormula _).isUFormula chosen _ (depth+1) 0 hna.symm,
              hib (depth+1)]
          · simp only [h0,h1,h2,if_false]
            exact atomCode_binder_fresh 0 _ _ chosen depth hr0 hna hnb

theorem positive_code_fresh (code : V) (h : 0 < code) (depth : V) :
    bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ code depth (decode code) = decode code :=
  decode_binder_fresh code code depth h le_rfl

/-- A direct client of the freshness theorem; no target set axiom or GEN rule
is assumed. This does not yet construct the internal Collection instance. -/
theorem decoded_positive_vacuity (T : SetTheory) [T.Δ₁] (code : V) (h : 0 < code) :
    Provable T (decode (_root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wim code
      (_root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wal code code))) :=
  decoded_vacuity_of_bindOne T code code (positive_code_fresh code h 0)

end LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedDecoderFreshness254

    termBindOneAt L a d (termBindOneAt L b e t) =
      termBindOneAt L b e (termBindOneAt L a d t) := termBindOneAt_commute h a b d e hab
example {k ts : V} (h : IsUTermVec L k ts) (a b d e : V) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    termBindOneVecAt L a d k (termBindOneVecAt L b e k ts) =
      termBindOneVecAt L b e k (termBindOneVecAt L a d k ts) := termBindOneVecAt_commute h a b d e hab
example {p : V} (h : IsUFormula L p) (a b d e : V) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    bindOneAt L a d (bindOneAt L b e p) =
      bindOneAt L b e (bindOneAt L a d p) := bindOneAt_commute h a b d e hab
example (r a b c d : V) (hr : (ℒₛₑₜ).IsRel 2 r) (ha : a ≠ c) (hb : b ≠ c) :
    bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ c d (atomCode r a b) = atomCode r a b :=
  atomCode_binder_fresh r a b c d hr ha hb
example (n c d : V) (hc : 0 < c) (h : n ≤ c) :
    bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ c d (decode n) = decode n := decode_binder_fresh n c d hc h
example (n d : V) (hn : 0 < n) : bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ n d (decode n) = decode n :=
  positive_code_fresh n hn d
example (T : SetTheory) [T.Δ₁] (n : V) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Provable T (decode (_root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wim n
      (_root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wal n n))) :=
  decoded_positive_vacuity T n hn
example (d : V) : bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ 1 d (decode (0 : V)) = decode (0 : V) :=
  decode_binder_fresh 0 1 d (by simp) (by simp)
example (d : V) : bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ 1 d (decode (1 : V)) = decode (1 : V) :=
  positive_code_fresh 1 (by simp) d
example (n : V) : bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ (n+1) 0 (decode n) = decode n :=
  decode_binder_fresh n (n+1) 0 (by simp) (by simp)
example (n : V) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Provable (𝗭𝗙 : SetTheory) (decode (_root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wim n
      (_root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wal n n))) :=
  decoded_positive_vacuity 𝗭𝗙 n hn

import ZFCinPA.ModelCodedDecoderAtomicVacuity254

set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
Positive source codes are fresh named labels for their own decoded formulas.
The proof uses internal Pi1 order induction, not external standardness or a
free-variable bound confused with the target syntax's bound-variable bound.
The literal decoder zero contains free label zero and is explicitly excluded.
-/
namespace LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedDecoderFreshness254
open LO LO.FirstOrder LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic.Bootstrapping LO.FirstOrder.SetTheory
open LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedBindOne
open LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedNamedBinderLaws
open LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedDecoder254
open LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedDecoderRho1_254
open LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedDecoderAtomicVacuity254
open scoped LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]
variable {L : Language} [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable]

private instance termBindOneAt_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₃[V] (termBindOneAt L) :=
  termBindOneAt_defined.graph_delta.to_definable
private instance bindOneAt_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₃[V] (bindOneAt L) :=
  bindOneAt_defined.graph_delta.to_definable
private instance decode_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₁[V] decode :=
  decode_defined.graph_delta.to_definable

lemma bindOneAt_isUFormula {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    ∀ chosen depth : V, IsUFormula L (bindOneAt L chosen depth p) := by
  apply IsUFormula.ISigma1.pi1_succ_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ p hp
  · definability
  · intro arity R terms hR ht a d
    rw [bindOneAt_rel a d hR ht]
    simp [hR,termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d ht]
  · intro arity R terms hR ht a d
    rw [bindOneAt_nrel a d hR ht]
    simp [hR,termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d ht]
  · intro a d; simp
  · intro a d; simp
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq a d
    rw [bindOneAt_and a d hp hq]
    simp [ihp a d,ihq a d]
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq a d
    rw [bindOneAt_or a d hp hq]
    simp [ihp a d,ihq a d]
  · intro p hp ih a d
    rw [bindOneAt_all a d hp]
    simp [ih a (d+1)]
  · intro p hp ih a d
    rw [bindOneAt_exs a d hp]
    simp [ih a (d+1)]

/-- Binding different free labels commutes when each keeps its own depth.
This is raw syntax; no claim swaps two quantified slots without substitution. -/
lemma termBindOneAt_commute {term : V} (ht : IsUTerm L term) :
    ∀ a b d e : V, a ≠ b →
    termBindOneAt L a d (termBindOneAt L b e term) =
      termBindOneAt L b e (termBindOneAt L a d term) := by
  apply IsUTerm.induction 𝚷 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ term ht
  · definability
  · intro z a b d e hab; simp
  · intro x a b d e hab
    classical
    by_cases ha : x = a
    · subst x
      simp [termBindOneAt_fvar,hab]
    · by_cases hb : x = b
      · subst x
        simp [termBindOneAt_fvar,hab.symm]
      · simp [termBindOneAt_fvar,ha,hb]
  · intro arity f terms hf hv ih a b d e hab
    rw [termBindOneAt_func b e hf hv,
      termBindOneAt_func a d hf (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b e hv),
      termBindOneAt_func a d hf hv,
      termBindOneAt_func b e hf (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d hv)]
    apply congrArg (fun args => ^func arity f args)
    apply nth_ext' arity
    · simp [termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b e hv]
    · simp [termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d hv]
    · intro i hi
      rw [nth_termBindOneVecAt a d (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b e hv) hi,
        nth_termBindOneVecAt b e hv hi,
        nth_termBindOneVecAt b e (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d hv) hi,
        nth_termBindOneVecAt a d hv hi]
      exact ih i hi a b d e hab

lemma termBindOneVecAt_commute {arity terms : V} (ht : IsUTermVec L arity terms)
    (a b d e : V) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    termBindOneVecAt L a d arity (termBindOneVecAt L b e arity terms) =
      termBindOneVecAt L b e arity (termBindOneVecAt L a d arity terms) := by
  apply nth_ext' arity
  · simp [termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b e ht]
  · simp [termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d ht]
  · intro i hi
    rw [nth_termBindOneVecAt a d (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b e ht) hi,
      nth_termBindOneVecAt b e ht hi,
      nth_termBindOneVecAt b e (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d ht) hi,
      nth_termBindOneVecAt a d ht hi]
    exact termBindOneAt_commute (ht.nth hi) a b d e hab

lemma bindOneAt_commute {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    ∀ a b d e : V, a ≠ b →
    bindOneAt L a d (bindOneAt L b e p) =
      bindOneAt L b e (bindOneAt L a d p) := by
  apply IsUFormula.ISigma1.pi1_succ_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ p hp
  · definability
  · intro arity R terms hR ht a b d e hab
    rw [bindOneAt_rel b e hR ht,
      bindOneAt_rel a d hR (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b e ht),
      termBindOneVecAt_commute ht a b d e hab,
      bindOneAt_rel a d hR ht,
      bindOneAt_rel b e hR (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d ht)]
  · intro arity R terms hR ht a b d e hab
    rw [bindOneAt_nrel b e hR ht,
      bindOneAt_nrel a d hR (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b e ht),
      termBindOneVecAt_commute ht a b d e hab,
      bindOneAt_nrel a d hR ht,
      bindOneAt_nrel b e hR (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a d ht)]
  · intro a b d e hab; simp
  · intro a b d e hab; simp
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq a b d e hab
    rw [bindOneAt_and b e hp hq,
      bindOneAt_and a d (bindOneAt_isUFormula hp b e) (bindOneAt_isUFormula hq b e),
      bindOneAt_and a d hp hq,
      bindOneAt_and b e (bindOneAt_isUFormula hp a d) (bindOneAt_isUFormula hq a d),
      ihp a b d e hab,ihq a b d e hab]
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq a b d e hab
    rw [bindOneAt_or b e hp hq,
      bindOneAt_or a d (bindOneAt_isUFormula hp b e) (bindOneAt_isUFormula hq b e),
      bindOneAt_or a d hp hq,
      bindOneAt_or b e (bindOneAt_isUFormula hp a d) (bindOneAt_isUFormula hq a d),
      ihp a b d e hab,ihq a b d e hab]
  · intro p hp ih a b d e hab
    rw [bindOneAt_all b e hp,
      bindOneAt_all a d (bindOneAt_isUFormula hp b (e+1)),
      bindOneAt_all a d hp,
      bindOneAt_all b e (bindOneAt_isUFormula hp a (d+1)),
      ih a b (d+1) (e+1) hab]
  · intro p hp ih a b d e hab
    rw [bindOneAt_exs b e hp,
      bindOneAt_exs a d (bindOneAt_isUFormula hp b (e+1)),
      bindOneAt_exs a d hp,
      bindOneAt_exs b e (bindOneAt_isUFormula hp a (d+1)),
      ih a b (d+1) (e+1) hab]

private lemma formula_at_depth {p : V} (hp : IsFormula L p) (depth : V) :
    IsSemiformula L depth p :=
  ⟨hp.isUFormula,le_trans hp.bv_le (by simp)⟩

lemma atomCode_binder_fresh (symbol a b chosen depth : V)
    (hr : (ℒₛₑₜ).IsRel 2 symbol) (ha : a ≠ chosen) (hb : b ≠ chosen) :
    bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ chosen depth (atomCode symbol a b) = atomCode symbol a b := by
  unfold atomCode
  rw [bindOneAt_rel chosen depth hr (by simp),
    termBindOneVecAt_pair chosen depth _ _ (by simp) (by simp),
    termBindOneAt_other chosen depth a ha,termBindOneAt_other chosen depth b hb]

/-- Internal order induction includes code zero only with a positive chosen
label. Every label read from a positive source row is strictly below its code. -/
theorem decode_binder_fresh (code : V) :
    ∀ chosen depth : V, 0 < chosen → code ≤ chosen →
    bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ chosen depth (decode code) = decode code := by
  induction code using ISigma1.pi1_order_induction
  · definability
  case ind code ih =>
    intro chosen depth hchosen hle
    have hr0 : (ℒₛₑₜ).IsRel (2 : V) 0 := by
      simpa using (isRel_quote_quote (V := V) (L := ℒₛₑₜ) (k := 2) (x := 0)).mpr
        ⟨Language.Set.Rel.eq,rfl⟩
    have hr1 : (ℒₛₑₜ).IsRel (2 : V) 1 := by
      simpa using (isRel_quote_quote (V := V) (L := ℒₛₑₜ) (k := 2) (x := 1)).mpr
        ⟨Language.Set.Rel.mem,rfl⟩
    by_cases hz : code = 0
    · subst code
      rw [decode_zero]
      unfold zeroFormula
      rw [bindOneAt_imp (formula_at_depth (memCode_isFormula 0 0) depth)
        (formula_at_depth (memCode_isFormula 0 0) depth) chosen,
        atomCode_binder_fresh 1 0 0 chosen depth hr1 (ne_of_lt hchosen) (ne_of_lt hchosen)]
    · have hpos : 0 < code := lt_of_le_of_ne (by simp) (Ne.symm hz)
      have ha := (child_bounds hpos).1
      have hb := (child_bounds hpos).2
      have hia (d : V) := ih _ ha chosen d hchosen (le_trans (le_of_lt ha) hle)
      have hib (d : V) := ih _ hb chosen d hchosen (le_trans (le_of_lt hb) hle)
      have hna : _root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCantor.first (code/4) ≠ chosen :=
        ne_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le ha hle)
      have hnb : _root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCantor.second (code/4) ≠ chosen :=
        ne_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hb hle)
      rw [decode_positive code hz]
      by_cases h0 : code%4 = 0
      · simp only [h0,if_pos]
        rw [bindOneAt_imp (formula_at_depth (decode_isFormula _) depth)
          (formula_at_depth (decode_isFormula _) depth) chosen,hia depth,hib depth]
      · by_cases h1 : code%4 = 1
        · rw [if_neg h0,if_pos h1]
          exact atomCode_binder_fresh 1 _ _ chosen depth hr1 hna hnb
        · by_cases h2 : code%4 = 2
          · rw [if_neg h0,if_neg h1,if_pos h2]
            unfold namedAll
            rw [bindOneAt_all chosen depth (bindOneAt_isSemiformula (decode_isFormula _) _).isUFormula,
              bindOneAt_commute (decode_isFormula _).isUFormula chosen _ (depth+1) 0 hna.symm,
              hib (depth+1)]
          · rw [if_neg h0,if_neg h1,if_neg h2]
            exact atomCode_binder_fresh 0 _ _ chosen depth hr0 hna hnb

theorem positive_code_fresh (code : V) (h : 0 < code) (depth : V) :
    bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ code depth (decode code) = decode code :=
  decode_binder_fresh code code depth h le_rfl

/-- A direct client of the freshness theorem; no target set axiom or GEN rule
is assumed. This does not yet construct the internal Collection instance. -/
theorem decoded_positive_vacuity (T : SetTheory) [T.Δ₁] (code : V) (h : 0 < code) :
    Provable T (decode (_root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wim code
      (_root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticCode254.wal code code))) :=
  decoded_vacuity_of_bindOne T code code (positive_code_fresh code h 0)

end LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedDecoderFreshness254
